summary.text: Shane Swett is the Republican candidate for Wyoming House of Representatives District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Ken Chestek.
A Laramie small business owner, he ran for the same seat in 2024 and lost to Chestek.

paragraphs.text: Shane Swett graduated from Laramie High School and holds a bachelor's degree from the University of Wyoming; Ballotpedia lists his profession as small business owner.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has built a business in Laramie.
Swett was the Republican nominee for Wyoming House District 13 in 2024, when Ken Chestek won the general election with 53.0 percent of the vote to Swett's 46.9 percent.
He advanced from the August 18, 2026 Republican primary to seek the seat again.

In the survey, he listed permanent and automatic property tax relief, attainable housing through less regulation, directing education dollars to classrooms rather than administration, and citizen leadership among his priorities.
